checks.name: the mapping says what it is: a study exercise, AI-drafted rationale
every provision in the brief's minimum list is present (mapped or explicitly not mapped)
every quoted statement and title is the pinned source text, verbatim
every cited Test ID is in the official run, and every count is recomputed from the raw records
support levels follow the rules (evidenced only with no deficient or gap record; Part 11 and Attest's activities at most partial; not mapped cites nothing)
no mapping text claims compliance, validation, certification or independence
every Test ID named in the prose exists in the official run
the CSA note is one page, names the four gaps, and its limitations are longer than its claims
every record carries a known verdict (not_measured is never counted as effective)
